surveyTemplate.name: ISO 27001 ISMS Transformation Pulse
surveyTemplate.description: Lightweight recurring pulse covering all 4 ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A themes. Complements full ISO 27001 Assessments (04-import.md/03-manual-entry.md) with a quick quarterly check-in for ISMS maturity tracking (07-survey.md).

questions.prompt: Is there an approved, communicated top-level information security policy?
Is there a current, owned inventory of information assets?
Are access rights provisioned, reviewed, and revoked in line with policy and role changes?
Are security requirements defined and embedded in supplier agreements?
Is there a documented, rehearsed incident response process from planning through post-incident learning?
Are candidates screened before employment, proportional to role risk?
Is ongoing security awareness/training provided appropriate to each role?
Do personnel have a clear mechanism to report suspected security events?
Is physical entry to secure areas controlled appropriate to sensitivity?
Is sensitive data/licensed software verified as removed before equipment disposal or reuse?
Are privileged access rights tightly restricted and managed?
Are technical vulnerabilities identified, evaluated, and remediated in a timely manner?
Are backups maintained and regularly tested per business/continuity requirements?
Is cryptography applied consistently per documented rules aligned to data classification?
Are security rules applied throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC)?
Are dev/test/production environments separated to reduce unauthorized change/access risk?

_notes.perThemeBreakdown: 5 Organizational, 3 People, 2 Physical, 6 Technological - weighted toward themes with the most controls (A.5/A.8), within the 10-30 recommended range in 07-survey.md
_notes.responseModel: Each SurveyResponse uses SurveyResponseLevel (VeryLow..VeryHigh, NotApplicable) per 02-data-model.md; optional numeric Score override.
_notes.domainCode/controlCode: Resolved to DomainId/ControlId at seed time by joining against the iso27001.json fixture (Framework must be seeded first).
